asks: Should the Project entity be kept (with Tasks belonging to an archivable Project) or removed entirely (flattening Tasks to stand alone)?
because: cs-002 adds `Project.archived: boolean` and rewrites deleteProject's spec — deepening Project's role — while cs-003 removes Project entirely, per its test "a Task can exist without belonging to any Project." Task currently has `project: ref:Project` as a required (non-optional) attribute, which cs-003 would have to change; the two changesets propose incompatible futures for the same entity and cannot both be implemented.

options.label: Adopt cs-002: keep Project, add archiving
options.detail: Project gains an `archived` boolean; deleteProject is rewritten to refuse deletion while incomplete Tasks remain, and archiving hides a Project from default listings without deleting its Tasks. Task keeps its required `project` reference.

options.label: Adopt cs-003: remove Project, flatten the model
options.detail: Project is removed entirely. Task's `project: ref:Project` attribute would need to become optional or be dropped, and every Project-referencing function (deleteProject, moveTask, etc.) would need to be reconsidered.

options.label: Decline both, keep Project as-is with no archiving
options.detail: Leave Project and Task unchanged; deleteProject keeps its current spec.
